title: Report bounded authored errors across execution boundaries
body:
Authored template and expression failures at execution boundaries currently fall back to generic internal errors. This change reports a fixed field, bounded cause and corrective action from the actual evaluation call. Deterministic faults in pinned definitions refuse Resume; provider acceptance, uncertain effects, cancellation, recovery and parent/child completion retain their existing precedence.

Closes #486. Part of #279.

The [D188 contract](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/486#issuecomment-7061825658) covers 26 boundaries, including workspace/script preparation, heartbeat, inference transforms and repair prompts, and subloop mappings. Per-invocation provenance distinguishes authored evaluation from provider, storage and binding faults. Newly typed JSONata sites omit evaluator-supplied messages from public errors and logs. Canonical-system rerender failures retain an engine-private correlated diagnostic under [D204](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/486#issuecomment-7065691011); existing Mutate/Exit, provider diagnostics and historical rows keep their separate contracts. No schema or dependency change is required.

Implementation and evidence are integrated at `b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1`, tree `86f422bb091515defe3d612df660988e5b47ffeb`, against main `a60843a9050b3a203726db84f6abf1f45b8bc694`. All 50 noncombined source paths equal corrected source `4d982162ca60e885d5af22f66076383a048215db`; four combined documentation files preserve both changes, with two explicitly qualified recovery instructions under [D209](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/486#issuecomment-7066877917). A fresh corrected run uses a published version in the UI or an explicitly selected editable draft through the API. Resume and Replay retain the original pinned definition.

- Actual Claude Fable 5.2 / xhigh approved [general review 1](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/553#issuecomment-7065654611) and [general review 2](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/553#issuecomment-7066208347) at their recorded sources. All three general slots are consumed. Fresh independent GPT-6.2 Astra MAX [scan 3 returned CHANGES_REQUIRED](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/553#issuecomment-7069931436) at b812: a new test expects a lexical temporary path where the adapter deliberately returns its physical path, and two relative fixtures can silently become absolute on cross-drive Windows hosts. Both are source-traced; the retained CI passed. D215 accepts a bounded test-only correction for both. No fourth general scan or renewed Astra approval is authorized.
- Original actual Opus 5.5 / xhigh [behavior QA remains CONDITIONAL](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/553#issuecomment-7066152036). The accepted bounded QA conjunction combines those source633 observations, [D205's source-bound prior executed controls](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/486#issuecomment-7066275144), and a separate independent source4d [29-scenario PASS](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/553#issuecomment-7066551212). All four workspace restart cases reached naturally with unchanged pinned definitions. Synthetic seams, API/MCP/browser versus fake-port scope, the failed first browser-instrumentation attempt and cleanup limitations remain explicit. The counts are not combined into a new test total.
- [The evidence archive](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/tree/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-486-authored-failures) preserves original reports, failed quota/local-coverage attempts, raw records and seals. D208 explicitly retains two nonrevoked disposable QA-store keys in original records; those stopped stores are retired from serving with the published keys. Twenty-two large historical proof members require their mapped local originals. [D211](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/486#issuecomment-7067027569) gives one historical conflict transcript its own marker-length attribute, preserving its bytes while the full diff check passes without exclusions. All 36,246 inherited/combined archive entries are exact.

**Draft: final review requires the bounded D215 correction.** [CI44950929794](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/44950929794) passed all six jobs for final evidence head `b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1` against current main `a60843a9050b3a203726db84f6abf1f45b8bc694`, tested merge `dde965f4e2263b954bc6462f3985b985ae324aa5`. The final run records 10,328 unit passes/53 skips, 488 browser passes, 27 Windows launcher passes and all 13 numerical coverage summaries above the unchanged 90% line/branch thresholds. Canonical native artifact `14725557325` (9,224 bytes, SHA-256 `c3be57ecb79fd011d384dfe1868730941bfca0f8c81353a3e6393040bf7cb145`) verifies all 338 records at that exact run/head/target/tree. The ordinary audit reports seven low and 13 moderate findings, zero high/critical.

The new [435-file corrective archive](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/tree/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-486-doc-correction) preserves the actual accepted correction review, static QA, failed run and bounded diagnosis. Its ordinary evidence commit passed raw/filtered/index/committed-byte verification and the full staged diff check while preserving all 37,997 previous nonpolicy entries. The two policy changes only append this new archive namespace.

The earlier [CI44934348117](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/44934348117) failed the browser job: 487 passed, one declared live-provider skip and one timeout in the cross-tab PWA voice-upload/update test. Repository checks, Coverage, Windows launcher, Template image and Gates passed; this is not an overall pass. The retained trace establishes that the second Update click received no subsequent main-frame navigation before the test deadline; the later cleanup request error masks that earlier wait. [The sealed trace diagnosis](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/553#issuecomment-7067769486) finds a verification-timeout symptom, with the underlying protocol stage unresolved. Exact web-source identity with main excludes a direct web-source change, but does not exclude indirect runtime effects or establish flakiness. [The bounded Windows diagnostics](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/553#issuecomment-7067985393) passed the target twice; the preceding-case invocation failed a separate offline-banner assertion and replaced its worker before the target. They do not explain the original Linux failure. [D213](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/486#issuecomment-7068023524) retains the unresolved observations in parked #555 and #556 without a speculative production change. No unchanged CI rerun occurred; the original run remains failed.

Independent [D209/D211 static QA passed](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/553#issuecomment-7067143342) at source `29e165e14fdda138300ba2a34585ddd47268b475`, carried byte-exact into this evidence-only child. Actual Claude Fable 5.2/xhigh [accepted the bounded correction](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/553#issuecomment-7069239772) after the reset, with the failed CI and D213 limits explicitly disclosed. This is the [D212](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/486#issuecomment-7067760005) corrective check, not general scan 3. Final CI and review gates are unchanged. The recorded b812 CI, numerical coverage and canonical native evidence are complete for that frozen head. D215 correction, actual opposite-family Claude delta review, separate independent native QA, an evidence archive, fresh corrected-head/current-target CI/native verification and explicit D035/D042 coordinator capped completion remain required before live merge-readiness checks and signed merge. The original negative final verdict remains intact. The original local coverage failures and optional/unobserved QA cases remain qualified evidence, not blanket passes. F3/F4 are separately parked in #554.
